cases.name: Mary Robin Walter
cases.about:
She was a nursing student at Barton County Community College.  

“Robin was truly beautiful inside and out,” her niece Leslie Schrag said.
cases.narrative: On 1/24/1980, her body was found at Nelson Trailer Park, which no longer exists.
